mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_consultation WHERE patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY status, create_time DESC
SELECT d.id, real_name AS realName, dept.name AS dept FROM sys_doctor as d LEFT JOIN sys_dept dept ON d.dept_id = dept.id
